To connect over USB, turn on USB debugging in Developer options on the phone, connect it to the PC, then run these commands on the PC.
To connect the webcam over Wi-Fi, run this command on the PC.
Camera access is not allowed, so the webcam cannot be used. Allow it in the Settings app.
Microphone access is not allowed, so only the speaker works.
Use the settings from the PC first
Anything the PC tool does not set uses these settings. If you change them while connected, they apply right away when the PC tool supports it, or from the next connection.
Wi-Fi connections were stopped after 5 wrong codes. Turn the switch off and on again to resume.
The GPU receiver accepts connections over USB (adb forward tcp:50300 localabstract:pocketgpu-gpu). It also listens on TCP port 50060, or on the next free port if 50060 cannot be used.
The phone is hot, so the frame rate is lowered to %1$d fps.
The camera can also be controlled from the PC app. If you change a setting in both places, the later change is used.
The new settings apply when the PC reconnects.
The PC software is old, so 90° and 270° rotation is not used. Please update the PC software.
Rotation, flipping, cropping, and keep level are not available on this device.
No camera was found on this device.
The mic failed to start and is trying again
Android did not allow the camera because the feature started while the app was not in front. The webcam was turned off. Keep the app open and turn the switch on again.
Android did not allow the microphone because the feature started while the app was not in front. Only the speaker works. Keep the app open and turn the speaker and mic switch off and on again.

Android did not allow the camera and microphone because the features started while the app was not in front. The webcam was turned off and only the speaker works. Keep the app open and turn the switches on again.
A connection from another app on this phone was refused.
A connection using an old command was refused. Use the commands below on the PC, or turn on “Also accept old PC tools” in Settings.
Keep performance up while the GPU works

While the PC is sending GPU work, this tells Android that the phone is being used like a game. Some phones then run the GPU faster. It stops when the PC disconnects, no work arrives for 2 minutes, or GPU is turned off. It may use a little more battery.
When on, old commands of the form adb forward tcp:50064 tcp:50064 also work. While it is on, other apps on this phone can also connect to the camera and mic, so turn it off when you are done.
At 90° and 270° the video is portrait. 4K is sent as 1080p.
Beyond %1$s, the picture gets softer as you zoom in.
Until a face is found, the center is cropped.
Zoom enlarges the center of the picture. Crop cuts out any part you choose and scales it to the selected resolution.
Keeps the picture level even if the phone is slightly tilted, up to 6°. The picture is zoomed in a little to leave room for the correction.
This camera has a fixed focus.
To reduce flicker from lights, use 1/50 or 1/100 where the power is 50 Hz, and 1/60 or 1/120 where it is 60 Hz.
Lower values look bluer and higher values look warmer.
With the front camera, the back light is used. If Android does not allow it, use the screen light instead.
The light is on only while the PC is connected.
Use the screen as a light
Turns the screen white at full brightness to light your face. Tap the screen to restore the brightness.
No stabilization. The delay is the shortest.
Reduces shake without adding delay. The picture is slightly narrower.
Reduces shake. The picture is slightly narrower and may be slightly delayed.
Automatically moves the framing to keep people in the picture.
Lower the frame rate when the phone is hot
When hot, 60 fps becomes 30 fps and 30 fps becomes 24 fps. When critical, 15 fps. It returns when the phone cools down.
Dim the screen automatically while connected
While the camera or mic is connected and the screen is not touched for the chosen time, the screen turns black at the lowest brightness. The camera and mic keep working. Tap the screen to return.
Uses the wired earphone mic while it is plugged in, and the phone mic after you unplug it.
The sound quality is lower while the Bluetooth mic is in use.
If the selected device is not connected, the phone mic is used.
Sends the mic with as little Android processing as possible. Good for recording.
Sends the mic with the standard Android processing.
Good for calls. Reduces background noise and the echo from the phone speaker.
While talking, set the input level to about -20 to -6 dBFS. Near 0 dBFS the sound clips.
Works on models whose built-in mic supports stereo. Unprocessed may be mono.
The receiver installed by start_android.cmd on the PC is used. The app receiver is not started.
